game.title: STAR WARS™ Knights of the Old Republic™ II - The Sith Lords™

roadmap.title: Peragus and Telos
roadmap.description: Play the prologue in full, save before the Peragus turret section, and finish the Telos Academy battle circle before leaving. Sell your inventory for credits and win the Pazaak games.

roadmap.title: Dantooine, Nar Shaddaa, Korriban and Dxun
roadmap.description: Visit the planets in an order that leaves one after Nar Shaddaa. Save before each Khoonda decision and each battle circle fight, and recruit Hanharr or Mira at the duel.

roadmap.title: Companions, skills and alignment
roadmap.description: Raise influence, alignment and skills while you finish the remaining planets, including Onderon. Use two playthroughs: Light Side male, then Dark Side female or the reverse.

roadmap.title: Endgame
roadmap.description: Reach level 30, defend Telos station, defeat Nihilus and Sion, then finish on one side.

achievements.summary: Finish the Prologue by setting course for Peragus as T3-M4.

steps.text: When you take control of @npc{T3-M4} on the @loc{Ebon Hawk}, choose to play the prologue. Do not skip it.
Play on and set course for @loc{Peragus} as @npc{T3-M4}. The achievement unlocks then.

achievements.displayName: It Was Like That When I Got Here!
achievements.summary: Order the Ebon Hawk to fire on the Peragus asteroids.

guide.context: This gives Dark Side points. Save first, and reload that save after the cutscene to take the other choice in the same run.

steps.text: Finish the turret section. @npc{Atton} then flies the ship into the asteroid field and asks what to do.
When he asks, order him to fire on the asteroids.

achievements.description: Let the Sith destroy the Peragus Asteroids
achievements.summary: Avoid firing at the Peragus asteroids so the Sith blow them up.

guide.context: Save first, and reload that save to take the other choice in the same run.

steps.text: Finish the turret section. @npc{Atton} then flies the ship into the asteroid field and asks what to do.
When he asks, order him to keep up evasive action. Pick the reply that says a survivor may remain on the station.

achievements.description: Get your first Light Side points
achievements.summary: Earn your first Light Side points.

guide.context: Turn on Options > Feedback > Tutorial Pop Ups first, or this will not unlock. One conversation allows only one of the two ending lines, so reload to get the other.

steps.text: In the @loc{Peragus morgue}, talk to @npc{Kreia} until you get two parting replies.
Choose "I'll return soon to make sure you're all right".

achievements.description: Get your first Dark Side points
achievements.summary: Earn your first Dark Side points.

guide.context: Turn on Options > Feedback > Tutorial Pop Ups first, or this will not unlock. One conversation allows only one of the two ending lines, so reload to get the other.

steps.text: In the @loc{Peragus morgue}, talk to @npc{Kreia} until you get two parting replies.
Choose "Just stay out of my way, or you'll end up like those corpses over there".

achievements.summary: Build your first lightsaber.

guide.context: You need several lightsaber parts and a lightsaber crystal.

steps.text: Get a lightsaber crystal, for example the named crystal in the @loc{Dantooine crystal caves}.
Settle the Czerka and Ithorian dispute for one part. The next planet's main quests give the rest.
Take the parts to @npc{Bao-Dur} aboard the @loc{Ebon Hawk}. He puts the lightsaber together.

achievements.summary: Defeat Darth Nihilus.

guide.context: Easier difficulty settings keep achievements active.

steps.text: Defend Telos station, then board @npc{Nihilus}' battleship and finish the objectives there. Fight and defeat him.

achievements.summary: Defeat Darth Sion on Malachor V.

guide.context: Heal often; with high Persuade you can weaken him in dialogue.

steps.text: Reach the end of @loc{Malachor V}. Fight @npc{Darth Sion} without your party and defeat him four times.

achievements.description: Complete the game on the Light Side
achievements.summary: Finish the game on the Light Side.

guide.context: Maximum alignment is not needed. Finale choices do not matter.

steps.text: Defeat @npc{Kreia} on @loc{Malachor V} with a Light Side alignment and talk with her. It unlocks as the game ends.

achievements.description: Complete the game on the Dark Side
achievements.summary: Finish the game on the Dark Side.

guide.context: Slight Dark Side alignment is enough. Reach maximum Dark Side first to earn the other alignment achievement too.

steps.text: Defeat @npc{Kreia} on @loc{Malachor V} with a Dark Side alignment. It unlocks as the game ends.

achievements.summary: Install HK-47's unique Pacifist Package module.

guide.context: Never tell HK-47 to stop asking before he kills. That blocks this.

steps.text: Recruit @npc{HK-47} first.
In the @loc{Nar Shadaa} Trade War quest, side with @npc{Geeda} when @npc{Oondar} asks which merchant to help.
Complete the main story on both @loc{Onderon} and @loc{Dantooine}. Their outcomes do not matter.
Speak to @npc{Geeda} and have her start trade with both planets. Then purchase the HK-47 Pacifist Package from her.
Tell @npc{HK-47} you have an upgrade for him and finish the talk.

achievements.description: Side with the Queen on Onderon
achievements.summary: Side with the Queen on Onderon.

guide.context: You choose on your first visit, but it unlocks near the end of the game. Pick one side per playthrough.

steps.text: On your first @loc{Onderon} visit, be Light Side inclined before you meet @npc{Master Kavar}, or refuse @npc{Tobin}'s offer once his soldiers burst into the cantina.
Finish the other planets, then play through the return to @loc{Onderon}.
Defeat @npc{Vaklu}. It unlocks whatever you do with him.

achievements.summary: Side with Vaklu on Onderon.

guide.context: You choose on your first visit, but it unlocks near the end of the game. Pick one side per playthrough.

steps.text: Be Dark Side, or finish the sidequest A Matter of Leadership, before you meet @npc{Master Kavar}.
Accept the offer from @npc{Vaklu}'s lieutenant.
Finish the other planets, then return to @loc{Onderon}. Kill both @npc{Kavar} and the Queen when you face them in the throne room.

achievements.summary: Win all five fights of the Handmaiden Battle Circle on Telos.

guide.context: Leaving Telos before you finish loses it for this playthrough. You cannot ask for a rematch after losing the fifth fight, so reload.

steps.text: After you meet @npc{Atris} at the academy, talk to any handmaiden to start the battle circle. Save before each fight.
Win fights 1 to 3 against one handmaiden each: unarmed first, then melee only, then no limits.
Win fight 4 against two handmaidens.

Save, then win fight 5 against five handmaidens alone. @mechanic{Force Push} knocks them off the mat and disqualifies them. Dark Side @mechanic{Force Lightning} hits the whole group. Lowering the difficulty does not void achievements.

achievements.summary: Win every fight in the Mandalorian Battle Circle on Dxun.

guide.context: Two rule violations end the quest for that save, so save before every fight and reload after a violation.

steps.text: Talk to the sergeant at the battle circle in the north of the camp and win the first three unarmed fights. You may choose the no-rules option.
Finish the Mandalorian scout quest: walk the jungle loop, defeat the two enemy groups, and return to the scout so he goes back to camp.
Beat the scout using the blade only, with no Force powers or items.
Challenge and beat the champion.

achievements.description: Repair the damaged droid on the Ebon Hawk
achievements.summary: Repair HK-47 on the Ebon Hawk by installing his four missing parts.

guide.context: The parts can come from other HK-50 drops or vendors too.

steps.text: Find a Vocabulator in the HK fight before the Republic cruiser on @loc{Peragus}.
Find a Control Cluster from the HKs on the snow mountain on @loc{Telos}.
Purchase a Droid Processor from the Aqualish vendor @npc{Kodin} in the main hub of @loc{Nar Shadaa}.
Take a Chassis from the HK droids at the end of @npc{T3-M4}'s warehouse mission on @loc{Nar Shadaa}.
Install the fourth part into @npc{HK-47} in the locked room in the middle of the @loc{Ebon Hawk}.

achievements.summary: Learn Moving Meditation from T3-M4.

guide.context: Raise Repair and Computer Use high; about 21 and 22 worked. Being kind to T3-M4 gives Light Side points.

steps.text: Be kind to @npc{T3-M4} on @loc{Peragus} and @loc{Telos}, and take part in his optional talks about @npc{Bastila} and @npc{Revan}.
When his influence is high, use the combined Repair and Computer Use modification on him on the @loc{Ebon Hawk}. It unlocks when he is modified.

achievements.summary: Learn Force Sight from Visas.

guide.context: Save first. Failing the influence check locks it for that save. Raise the Handmaiden's influence before Visas'.

steps.text: Reach moderate or high alignment, return to the @loc{Ebon Hawk} and beat @npc{Visas} in a duel to recruit her.
Talk with her and be kind: treat her as a person, say @npc{Nihilus} was wrong and stress her worth.
Ask how she sees. When the influence check passes she teaches you Force Sight.

achievements.summary: Recruit Hanharr.

guide.context: This needs a Dark Side character. Light Side characters play Mira instead.

steps.text: During the Nar Shadaa story, win the duel after @npc{Visquis} pits @npc{Hanharr} against @npc{Mira}.
Finish the story scenes until @npc{Hanharr} talks with @npc{Atton} about the yacht. The achievement unlocks then.

achievements.summary: Recruit Mira.

guide.context: This needs a Light Side or grey character. Dark Side characters play Hanharr instead.

steps.text: During the Nar Shadaa story, win the duel after @npc{Visquis} pits @npc{Mira} against @npc{Hanharr}.
Finish the story scenes until @npc{Mira} talks with @npc{Atton} about the yacht. The achievement unlocks then.

achievements.summary: Loot a body on Korriban.

guide.context: The Hssiss that spawn do not need to be beaten.

steps.text: Leave the @loc{Ebon Hawk} on @loc{Korriban}. Loot one of the bodies just ahead and to the left. @npc{Kreia} warns you not to.

achievements.summary: Flee Korriban after fighting Darth Sion.

steps.text: Take the dead Jedi master's datapad to open the academy door. @npc{Darth Sion} attacks on your way out and heals when hurt.
When @npc{Kreia} tells you to flee, choose any reply.

achievements.summary: Break Hanharr's spirit.

guide.context: Go to Nar Shadaa right after Telos if you can. Keep one planet unvisited after Nar Shadaa. Otherwise Kreia sends you to Dantooine and the talk is lost.

steps.text: With only @npc{Hanharr} in the party, kill @npc{Lootra} and @npc{Lavassou} in their homes in the @loc{Docks}.
Choose "I heard you hunt humans" and take the first reply each time until "But still you serve me, as a slave should. You know your place" appears.

Bring up @npc{Mira}. With Awareness above 12 pick "And you were angry at her weakness - and rightfully so". With Persuade above 10 pick "If Mira spared your life, it was more likely to humilate you before others than mercy."

Ask why he wears shackles, taking the first reply until "Perhaps you are weak in that you allowed the shackles to be placed at all". Then pick "You lessen an act of slaughter by thinking it was salvation". After that pick "What you did to your people was madness - yet there was strength in it."
When he asks about the Mandalorian Wars, answer "If you think such deaths bother me, they do not".
Ask @npc{Kreia} about @npc{Hanharr} and take her task. Ask him about his source of strength, then "Why do you follow me?".
Pick "Does this mean you serve me?". Next pick "the debt you mentioned...". Then the first replies until his spirit breaks.

achievements.description: Beat the champ on Nar Shadaa
achievements.summary: Beat the Champ at the Nar Shadaa pazaak den.

steps.text: Learn the den's password from the @npc{Chadra-Fan} beside the cantina door. Take @npc{Atton} and @npc{T3-M4} with you.
Beat the @npc{Duros} by passing a Persuade check about his friends waiting outside.
Let @npc{Atton} play the @npc{Twi'lek}. For the droid, repair its gambling error with high skills or with @npc{T3-M4}, and choose the non-repair option when asked if she minds.
Face the Champ and ask who he is. Keep asking why he plays when he never loses, then pass the Persuade check.

achievements.summary: Get the crystal named after your character from the Dantooine crystal caves.

guide.context: You can return to the caves later, so it is not missable.

steps.text: In the @loc{Dantooine crystal caves} go as far north-east as you can until @npc{Kreia} speaks.
Kill the monsters that appear, then take the large glowing crystal in the middle.
When @npc{Kreia} replies, choose the pet rock line.

achievements.description: Side with the Settlers at Khoonda
achievements.summary: Side with the settlers at Khoonda against the mercenaries.

guide.context: Save before the final decision. Reload that save to take the other result in the same run.

steps.text: After you free @npc{Vrook} and leave the caves, lie to the mercenary leader about helping.
Return to @loc{Khoonda}. Fix the patrol droids, treat wounded soldiers, repair the security door and sign up more soldiers. A high Persuade lets you give the soldiers a speech.
After the battle cutscene, side against the mercenaries. Talk to the administrator and take or refuse the reward.

achievements.description: Change your mind about siding with the Settlers at Khoonda
achievements.summary: Side with the Khoonda settlers, then hand over the administrator to the mercenaries.

guide.context: Save before the final decision. Reload that save to take the other result in the same run.

steps.text: Side with the settlers until the battle: lie to the mercenary leader, then return to @loc{Khoonda}. Fix the patrol droids, treat wounded soldiers, repair the security door and sign up more soldiers.
When the battle ends, give @npc{Adare} to the mercenaries and take their side.

achievements.summary: Recruit the Handmaiden as a male character.

guide.context: Only a male character can recruit her. A female character recruits the Disciple instead.

steps.text: Finish @loc{Telos Academy}, leave, and watch the recording of your trial. She joins, and the achievement unlocks.

achievements.summary: Recruit the Disciple as a female character.

guide.context: Only a female character can recruit him. A male character recruits the Handmaiden instead.

steps.text: In the @loc{Jedi Enclave} on @loc{Dantooine}, open the door into the large room with shelves, a statue and dead mercenaries. The conversation starts at once and he joins you.

achievements.summary: Reach level 15 in your starting class and take a prestige class.

guide.context: You need moderate Light or Dark Side alignment for Kreia to offer one.

steps.text: At level 15 in your starting class, talk to @npc{Kreia} and pick any of the three new classes.

achievements.summary: Reach maximum Light Side alignment.

guide.context: Some Dark Side points on the way do no harm.

steps.text: Choose Light Side options, be kind, refuse quest rewards and take the Light Side ending of story quests. It unlocks the moment you reach the maximum.

achievements.summary: Reach maximum Dark Side alignment.

guide.context: Some Light Side points on the way do no harm.

steps.text: Choose Dark Side options and the Dark Side ending of story quests. It unlocks the moment you reach the maximum.

achievements.description: Win a Pazaak game with a full board
achievements.summary: Win a Pazaak game after placing nine cards.

steps.text: On @loc{Telos}, buy the nearer @npc{Duros} merchant's negative cards, then buy the cantina woman's plus/minus and negative cards.
Play her with as many plus/minus cards in your deck as you can and the rest negative. Start playing negative cards early.
Hold a plus/minus card for your last cards so the ninth card wins the set. Winning one set is enough.

achievements.summary: Collect 10,000 credits.

steps.text: Save on @loc{Telos} once you are free with your gear back. Then sell your whole inventory to the @npc{Duros} vendors on the east side.

achievements.summary: Raise your own Persuade skill over 30.

guide.context: Gear bonuses count, such as Regal Headgear or Jal Shey robes. Only your own character counts.

steps.text: Put points into Persuade at every level-up. Raise Charisma and take the Empathy feats for extra help.

achievements.description: Kill all Sith troopers before they can board the Ebon Hawk
achievements.summary: Kill every Sith trooper with the Ebon Hawk turret before any of them boards the ship.

guide.context: Any Sith you fight after the turret section fails this. Reload the save you made before entering the ship.

steps.text: Make a save just before you board the @loc{Ebon Hawk} to leave @loc{Peragus}.
Man the turret and shoot the Sith running through the hangar toward the lone boarding ramp. The turret has unlimited charge.
Go straight from the turret to @npc{Atton} saying you should leave. If a Sith reaches the ship, reload and retry.

achievements.summary: Have ten characters unlocked on the Party Selection screen.

guide.context: Either character of each pair counts: Handmaiden or Disciple, Mira or Hanharr.

steps.text: Recruit @npc{HK-47} by repairing him, and recruit @npc{Visas} by earning moderate Light or Dark Side alignment and beating her in a duel on the @loc{Ebon Hawk}.
Add the story characters. The achievement unlocks when the tenth joins.

achievements.description: Reduce a companion's Influence to zero.
achievements.summary: Reduce a companion's influence to zero.

guide.context: Light Side companions like Handmaiden and Atton are easiest. Save first if you still need that companion.

steps.text: Take a Light Side companion to @loc{Nar Shaddaa}. Kill the optional people in the flophouse and be cruel to beggars and others.
Or antagonize the Handmaiden when she complains about @npc{Visas} until she stops talking.

achievements.summary: Acquire every Dark Side power.

guide.context: Avoid Sith Lord as the prestige class. Take the class-only powers of Marauder or Assassin if you choose one.

collectibles.name: Wound, Choke, Kill
collectibles.method: Pick Wound, then Choke, then Kill.

collectibles.name: Slow, Affliction, Plague
collectibles.method: Pick Slow, then Affliction, then Plague.

collectibles.name: Fear, Horror, Insanity
collectibles.method: Pick Fear, then Horror, then Insanity.

collectibles.name: Shock, Force Lightning, Force Storm
collectibles.method: Pick Shock, then Force Lightning, then Force Storm.

collectibles.name: Drain Life, Death Field
collectibles.method: Pick Drain Life, then Death Field.

collectibles.name: Drain Force line
collectibles.method: Pick Drain Force, then Improved Drain Force, then Master Drain Force.

collectibles.name: Force Scream line
collectibles.method: Pick Force Scream, then Improved Force Scream, then Master Force Scream.

collectibles.name: Prestige class powers
collectibles.method: Sith Marauder: Fury 1 to 3. Sith Assassin: Force Camouflage, then Improved, then Master. Skip this item if you take neither class.

collectibles.name: Dantooine power
collectibles.method: Also take the last power the game gives you on Dantooine.

achievements.summary: Acquire every Light Side power.

guide.context: Jedi Master-only powers are not needed.

collectibles.name: Heal line
collectibles.method: Pick Heal, then Improved Heal, then Master Heal.

collectibles.name: Force Aura line
collectibles.method: Pick Force Aura, then Force Shield, then Force Armor.

collectibles.name: Force Valor line
collectibles.method: Pick Force Valor, then Knight Valor, then Master Valor.

collectibles.name: Force Barrier line
collectibles.method: Pick Force Barrier, then Improved Force Barrier, then Master Force Barrier.

collectibles.name: Revitalize line
collectibles.method: Pick Revitalize, then Improved Revitalize, then Master Revitalize.

collectibles.name: Stun line
collectibles.method: Pick Stun, then Stasis, then Stasis Field.

collectibles.name: Stun Droid line
collectibles.method: Pick Stun Droid, then Disable Droid, then Destroy Droid.

collectibles.name: Dantooine power
collectibles.method: Also take the last power the game gives you on Dantooine.

achievements.summary: Dance for Vogga in the Nar Shadaa cantina.

steps.text: In the cantina, go right from the entrance and speak to the @npc{Twi'lek} left of the doorway about dancing for @npc{Vogga}.
Volunteer yourself, or the Handmaiden or Mira. The achievement unlocks after the cutscene.

achievements.summary: Kill all three Jedi masters.

guide.context: Dark Side only. Once you spare one you cannot kill him later.

steps.text: Delay the fights. Do Korriban or Onderon first, then the other, then Nar Shaddaa, and Dantooine last.
Choose to kill each master when the option appears, including the Jedi protecting the Queen on @loc{Onderon}.
When told to meet at the @loc{Jedi Temple} on @loc{Dantooine}, @npc{Kreia} scolds you and it unlocks.

achievements.summary: Reach player level 30.

guide.context: Kreia in your party boosts XP.

steps.text: Complete every quest and fight as much as you can. Try to reach level 30 before the final fight with @npc{Kreia}.
If you are close, place mines in one area, change zone and return. Recovering them gives about 100 XP each.

achievements.summary: Reach base Stealth of 30 on any character.

guide.context: Gear and attribute bonuses do not count. Caution adds +3.

steps.text: Spend level-up points on Stealth for you or a companion such as @npc{Atton}. Do not auto-level.

achievements.summary: Reach base Demolitions of 30 on any character.

guide.context: Gear and attribute bonuses do not count. Caution adds +3.

steps.text: Spend level-up points on Demolitions for a companion such as @npc{G0-T0}, @npc{Hanharr} or @npc{HK-47}. Do not auto-level.

achievements.displayName: I've Seen How You Use a Hydrospanner
achievements.summary: Reach base Repair of 30 on any character.

guide.context: Gear and attribute bonuses do not count. Gear Head feats add +3.

steps.text: Give a dedicated companion every Repair point at level-up. Do not auto-level.

achievements.displayName: We Have to Hack Into the Mainframe!
achievements.summary: Reach base Computer Use of 30 on any character.

guide.context: Gear and attribute bonuses do not count. Gear Head feats add +3.

steps.text: Give a dedicated companion every Computer Use point at level-up. Do not auto-level.

achievements.summary: Reach base Treat Injury of 30 on any character.

guide.context: Gear and attribute bonuses do not count. Empathy adds +3.

steps.text: Give a companion such as @npc{Mira} the Treat Injury points at level-up. Do not auto-level.

achievements.description: Get this by starting the "Trapped" Quest on Korriban.
achievements.summary: Start the Trapped quest on Korriban.

steps.text: Enter the @loc{Sith Academy} on @loc{Korriban}. A scene with @npc{Darth Sion} plays and the achievement unlocks right after.

achievements.description: Convince Vogga the Hutt to sell fuel to Telos.
achievements.summary: Get Vogga the Hutt to agree to supply fuel for Telos.

steps.text: Ask @npc{Vogga} about the fuel on @loc{Telos}. He agrees if the blockade is removed.
Finish the Nar Shadaa story and destroy @npc{G0-T0}'s yacht, then speak to @npc{Vogga} again.

achievements.description: Convince the "champ" to lose the game without playing.
achievements.summary: Persuade the Nar Shadaa pazaak Champ to lose on purpose.

steps.text: Dispose of the three other players, then approach the Champ. Ask who he is and why he keeps playing when he never loses.
Pass the Persuade check so he throws the game.

achievements.summary: Claim Darth Nihilus' mask.

guide.context: Visas must be in your party. Save before the Nihilus fight.

steps.text: After the fight, @npc{Visas} asks to look at the body. Choose the option that allows it and tells her to bring the mask to you.

achievements.description: Have your character replace any of the Sith Lords on the main menu screen.
achievements.summary: Have your character replace a Sith Lord on the main menu.

guide.context: If a later Light Side run pushed your character off, reload a Dark Side save. If it does not unlock, restart the game.

steps.text: Finish the game on the Dark Side. Your character appears on the main menu in place of @npc{Sion} or @npc{Nihilus}.

achievements.description: Teach the Handmaiden the ways of the Force.
achievements.summary: As a male character, train the Handmaiden in the Force.

guide.context: Only a male character can do this. It needs a lot of Handmaiden influence.

steps.text: Raise her influence: take her with you and help Light Side people, such as giving passports on @loc{Onderon}.
On the @loc{Ebon Hawk}, win her training fights. The third needs level 18.
After her talk about her parents, ask @npc{Kreia} about the Handmaiden's mother, then return to the Handmaiden and pass an influence check.
Pick training a fourth time and say she could learn from you. Pass the second influence check.

achievements.displayName: You ARE the droid I'm looking for
achievements.summary: Deduce G0-T0's identity.

guide.context: You need high G0-T0 influence and at least three clues.

steps.text: Raise his influence by asking how to save the Republic. At the end of that talk, the reply to use is "If I have to kill everyone to do it, you'll get your stability."

Ask about his criminal operations. Bring up at least three clues: the Pazaak droid's memory module, @npc{Borna Lys} on the cheating racing droid, the Bith scientist quest, @npc{T3-M4}'s yacht codes, or his droids failing at the @loc{Jekk'Jekk Tarr}.
Say "I think you used droids in your operations because you are a droid". Use "A lot of your operations on Nar Shaddaa were carried out by droids" first if needed.
If it does not unlock, pick "So you were the droid for Citadel station".

achievements.description: Learn how to kill Jedi from HK-47
achievements.summary: Hear HK-47 explain how to kill a Jedi.

guide.context: You need very high HK-47 influence, gained by cruelty and killing.

steps.text: Once his influence is near the maximum, say "If I need to kill a Jedi, how would I do it?" and pass the influence check.

achievements.description: Listen to HK-47's definition of love.
achievements.summary: Hear HK-47 describe what he thinks love is.

steps.text: Recruit @npc{HK-47}. Let one companion's influence run well above the other's: Visas and the Handmaiden for a male character, the Disciple and Atton for a female one.
After you hear the two companions fight, ask @npc{HK-47} what love is. It unlocks during the answer.
